title_zh: 核对货运范围后索取末段配送报价

scenario.label_zh: 核对货运报价包含的运输范围
scenario.goal_zh: 明确现有运费只包含到仓库的运输，并约定补报送到展馆的费用后再决定

context_zh: 展览筹办人与货运公司核对木箱货物的报价。
author: author-phase10-a

sentences.speaker: Alma
sentences.text: The cargo is four wooden crates for an exhibition. Does your price include delivery to the gallery?

sentences.speaker: Declan
sentences.text: No. The carriage charge covers transport to our city warehouse only.

sentences.speaker: Alma
sentences.text: I need the crates at the gallery entrance, not waiting at a warehouse. Can you quote for that final leg too?

sentences.speaker: Declan
sentences.text: Yes. I'll add a separate delivery line so you can see the full cost.

sentences.speaker: Alma
sentences.text: Please send the revised quote before booking any transport.

sentences.speaker: Declan
sentences.text: Understood. I'll send the price for both stages, and wait for your decision.
